Company description:
Scandinavian Airlines System SAS
Job description:  Challenges you will work on 
At SAS, machine learning has moved well beyond experimentation. As part of our ongoing Digital & IT transformation, we are expanding our investments in machine learning, automation, data platforms, and Generative AI. We design, deploy, and operate production models that support pricing decisions, personalize customer experiences, and make our operations smarter every day.
 As a Machine Learning Engineer, you will play an important role in developing, deploying, and maintaining machine learning solutions that create real business value. You will work closely with data scientists, data engineers, and AI engineers to help bring models from development into production and ensure they perform reliably at scale.
 If you're passionate about applying machine learning to real-world challenges and want to help shape the future of AI at SAS, this is the role for you!
 As our Machine Learning Engineer, you will help develop and operationalize machine learning solutions across SAS. In this role, you will work hands-on with deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement of production ML solutions.
 You will collaborate closely with data scientists to transition models from experimentation to production, help improve deployment processes and contribute to the ongoing development of our ML platform and engineering practices.
 Key Responsibilities
  Design, develop, test, deploy and monitor end-to-end pipelines for machine learning models in Azure.
 Apply MLOps best practices, including version control, continuous integration, continuous delivery, continuous training, testing, and monitoring, to ensure the quality and reliability of the machine learning solutions.
 Monitor model performance and help identify issues related to model quality, drift, and reliability.
 Support automation of model training, deployment, and retraining processes.
 Contribute to best practices for machine learning engineering, testing, documentation, and deployment.
 Work with Data Engineering and IT teams to ensure solutions are scalable, secure, and reliable.
 Help develop and improve CI/CD processes for machine learning applications.
 Participate in troubleshooting and resolving issues in production ML systems.
 Stay up to date with developments in machine learning, MLOps, and cloud technologies.
  The Team 
We are a central AI & Automation function within SAS Digital & IT that develops and operates solutions across machine learning, automation, MLOps, and Generative AI. Our team consists of data scientists, AI engineers, ML engineers, and automation specialists who work together to deliver solutions that create measurable business impact.
 As SAS continues to strengthen its AI capabilities, we are investing in modern cloud platforms, scalable AI solutions, and engineering practices that enable machine learning to create value across the business.
 As part of the team, you will contribute to a growing portfolio of machine learning products and collaborate across disciplines to ensure solutions are production-ready, scalable, and valuable to the business.
 To be successful we believe you have  Master's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Machine Learning, Mathematics, or a related field.
 2-5 years of experience in Machine Learning Engineering, MLOps, or a related role.
 Experience developing, deploying, and operating machine learning solutions in production environments.
 Hands-on experience with Azure ML, Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, or similar cloud-based ML platforms.
 Proficiency in Python, SQL, Git, and Bash.
 Experience deploying and serving machine learning models through APIs, as well as monitoring model performance in production.
 Understanding of model evaluation techniques, hyperparameter tuning, and validation approaches such as back-testing.
 Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform on Azure.
 Solid understanding of software engineering practices, including testing, version control, and CI/CD principles.
 Strong communication skills and the ability to explain and document technical concepts clearly and effectively.
 Experience with Generative AI, LLMs, or AI agents is considered a plus.
  
We believe you are a curious and pragmatic engineer who enjoys solving problems with data and machine learning. You are comfortable working across the ML lifecycle, from experimentation to production, and enjoy collaborating with colleagues from different disciplines.
 You are eager to learn, improve your technical skills, and contribute to building reliable AI solutions that create real business value. Most importantly, you understand that successful machine learning is not only about models, but about delivering solutions that work in the real world and continue to provide value over time.
  
 Additional information  Apply by November 16, 2026. We review applications continuously and encourage you to apply early, as the position may be filled before the closing date. Please note that, due to GDPR regulations, we cannot accept applications via email.
 This is a full-time position (100%) based at our headquarters in Frösundavik, Solna, Stockholm. We value in-person collaboration, although flexible working arrangements may be available depending on team and business needs.
 As this role contributes to security-classified systems and business-critical capabilities, a background check will be conducted as part of the final stage of the recruitment process.

jobs.title: AI Backend Engineer
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced AI Backend Engineer to build the core intelligence layer of a fast-scaling AI company backed by NVIDIA, Microsoft, and AWS.
About Antrino
Antrino Labs is building the platform that makes every square meter intelligent.
The physical world runs on processes nobody can actually see. Goods move, machines idle, space goes unused, and decisions about all of it are based on samples, guesses, and reports written after the fact. Antrino lets any organization deploy vision intelligence into a physical space and get back what is actually happening there, as structured, real-time information it can act on. Not a research project or a custom integration, but a platform where you describe what matters and deploy it.
We have grown from 6 people to a team of 28 in less than a year, closed our Seed round, announced together with Dagens Industri, and are registered with Inspektionen för strategiska produkter (ISP), the Swedish authority for strategic and dual-use products. Everything we build follows Privacy by Design.
The role
You will build the services that turn a customer's intent into working intelligence.
When a customer builds something in Studio, our composition canvas, that graph has to become a running system: a plan that decides which models to call, in what order, gated by cost and confidence, and that produces events and evidence a customer can trust. You will work on the compiler that turns the graph into an execution plan, the runtime that executes it, and the Python and TypeScript services that detection, classification, and measurement run through.
You will also work on our Agent, which interviews customers, proposes and edits these graphs, and deploys them with confirmation. Getting an LLM to reliably manipulate a structured graph, validate it, and explain its reasoning is a real engineering problem, not a prompting exercise.
The role sits between the team building our first-party detection models and the engineers building the product interface. It is backend systems engineering for a product whose core logic is built out of AI calls.
What you will work on
Backend services for detection, classification, and measurement, largely in Python with FastAPI
The compiler that turns a Studio graph into an execution plan, and the runtime that deploys and runs it
Routing logic that decides which model handles which work, including cost gating where a cheap model decides when an expensive one runs
The Agent's interview, graph-editing, and deployment flows that turn natural language into a working pipeline
Integrating our first-party detection models, and frontier model APIs where they do something ours do not yet, behind one clean interface
Turning raw model output into structured, auditable events and evidence an operator can trust
APIs and data models for streams, behaviors, runs, and events in PostgreSQL with row-level security
Tests and evaluation harnesses for logic that includes non-deterministic model calls
Debugging production issues that span a customer request, our orchestration, and the model call underneath



Our stack
You do not need experience with all of this, but you should recognize most of it and be able to argue about it.
Backend: Python, FastAPI, TypeScript, Node.jsData: PostgreSQL through Supabase, with row-level security, 
Streaming: RTSP ingestion, RTSP→HLS conversion, live and archive pipelines
Infrastructure: Azure, GitHub Actions, on-site compute reached over Tailscale
Who we are looking for Substantial backend experience on production systems, ideally where an LLM or ML model was part of the core logic rather than a bolted-on feature
Strong Python, and comfort in TypeScript or Node.js
Real experience designing APIs, data models, and service boundaries, including PostgreSQL
Experience building with LLM APIs beyond a chat wrapper: tool use, structured output, agentic flows, or a model as one step in a larger pipeline
An understanding of how to test systems with non-deterministic components
Experience with real-time or streaming data is a strong advantage
Excellent written and spoken English. Swedish is a plus, not a requirement



You can reason about a graph or compiler-shaped problem even if you have never built a compiler. You make decisions with incomplete information, take responsibility for the outcome, and say so clearly when something you built was wrong.
Life at Antrino
You will join a team of driven, ambitious people who thrive at a fast pace and enjoy working together. We go to AI events, host our own, and end plenty of weeks with an afterwork. You will work closely with our engineers in Stockholm and our growing team in Bangalore.
What we offer
Direct access to the founders, the engineering team, and customers
Real ownership of a core layer of the platform rather than delegated tickets
Potential participation in our stock option programme after the probationary period
Hardware of your choice
AI events, afterworks, team activities, and travel when the business requires it
Occupational pension, insurance, and friskvårdsbidrag



Process
Introductory conversation about your background and the role
Technical conversation about systems you have built and why you made the decisions you made. No whiteboard algorithm puzzles
Working session with the engineering team on a real problem from our stack
Conversation with the founders about options and terms



We review applications continuously. References may be requested at the final stage.
Apply with your CV and, if you have one, a link to something you have built. A repository, a shipped product, or a short note about a system you are proud of tells us more than a cover letter

jobs.description:
Are you interested in working with research in Computational Science, with the support of competent and friendly colleagues in an international environment? Are you looking for an employer that invests in sustainable employeeship and offers safe, favourable working conditions? We welcome you to apply for a PhD position at the Department of Information Technology, Uppsala University.

The Department of Information Technology holds a leading position in both research and education at all levels. We are currently Uppsala University's third largest department, with 350 employees, including 120 teachers and 120 PhD students. Approximately 5,000 undergraduate students take one or more courses at the department each year. You can find more information about us on the Department of Information Technology website.

**Project description**  
The project focuses on the development of computational and data-driven methods for epidemiological modelling and analysis. A central component is the development of stochastic models and Bayesian methods for combining epidemiological models with different types of data, with the aim of enabling reliable estimates and situational awareness. The project offers several possible research directions, including statistical validation and diagnostics for simulation-based inference, the use of neural networks to construct informative prior distributions, and game-theoretic modelling of epidemics and the value of information in decisions concerning public health interventions. The common foundation is computational modelling and Bayesian inference, while the specific research direction can be adapted to the doctoral candidate's background and interests. The project thus offers opportunities to work at the intersection of applied mathematics, statistics, machine learning and computational science, with epidemiological applications providing a common focus.

A more detailed project description is available at: https://stefanengblom.github.io/files/docs/Comput\_Modeling\_Epidemics.pdf

**Duties**  
The doctoral student will primarily devote their time to graduate education. Other departmental duties of at most 20%, including teaching and administration, may also be included in the employment.

**Requirements**  
To meet the general entry requirements for doctoral studies, you must:

* hold a Master’s (second-cycle) degree in Computational Science, Enigineering Physics, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, or a related subject, or
* have completed at least 240 credits in higher education, with at least 60 credits at Master’s level including an independent project worth at least 15 credits, or

Experience in scientific programming and the ability to implement and evaluate computational methods are required. Good written and spoken English is also required, as the research and scientific communication will be conducted in English.

The position requires the ability to work independently and take responsibility for one's own research, as well as to collaborate effectively with others. The candidate should have strong analytical and problem-solving skills, a structured approach to work, and the ability to communicate research results clearly.

**Additional qualifications**  
Experience in one or more of the following areas is considered an advantage:

* Bayesian statistics, statistical inference or simulation-based inference.
* Stochastic modelling, numerical methods or scientific computing.
* Machine learning, particularly neural networks and probabilistic machine learning.
* Sequential Monte Carlo methods, particle filtering or state estimation.
* Mathematical optimization or game theory.
* Epidemiological modelling or other applications involving dynamical systems.

Experience with programming in Matlab, Python, R, C or C++ is beneficial. Previous experience with research software, simulation frameworks or the analysis of real-world data is also an advantage.

In your application and personal letter, please state clearly how your background fulfills the requirements and aligns with the additional qualifications.

Rules governing PhD students are set out in the Higher Education Ordinance chapter 5, §§ 1-7 and in Uppsala University's rules and guidelines.

* **Online product.** We sell 3D scanning and recommendation web components that our business customers integrate into their online store. It allows online shoppers to scan their own feet using their own phone and get size recommendations for the footwear in that online store.

jobs.title: AI Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Join the Revolution in Commercial Vehicle Tech at Coretura!
Our AI Lab builds the shared platform that teams across Coretura use to develop and run AI products safely and reliably. We're looking for a senior software engineer to help design, build and run it.
What you’ll do
You will work with the AI Lab to set the platform's technical direction, and take on a large share of the hands-on work yourself. Together, you'll build the platform that gives teams access to AI models across providers, manages and retrieves the data their AI products rely on, and provides the harnesses agents are built and run in. You'll also build agents yourself, and the observability that shows whether an AI product is giving the right answers, not just whether it's running.
Beyond that, your work will include:

Security and safety by level: controls and evaluations that scale with how autonomous an AI system is and how safety-critical its use is, from everyday AI tools to autonomous agents, with prompt injection defences built in. The higher the level, the more a system has to prove before release and the more closely it's monitored once live. You'll build this together with our Security Hub.


Cost and resilience: usage metering built into the platform so teams can see what their AI products consume, and recovery tested for each AI product as a whole (model, knowledge base, prompts and tool integrations), not just the servers it runs on.


AI assets as code: prompts, agent definitions, model versions and evaluation datasets, versioned and released through automated pipelines. They change often and any change can shift how a product behaves, so every change is automatically tested, evaluated and traceable before it ships.


Build to discover, then share what you learn. When we need to know whether an approach works, you build a working version, then use it to help colleagues across Coretura understand what works, what doesn't and why. As a senior engineer, you'll combine those findings with your own experience to help set where the platform goes next. You'll use AI coding agents in your own daily work and help other engineers adopt them safely. You'll also review designs and code, mentor the engineers around you, and hand over ownership of components as they're ready for it.
You'll report to the AI Lab Lead and work closely with our Digital Architect and the teams behind our developer and data platforms.
What you bring
A solid background in software engineering, but we care far more about what you've done than how long you've been doing it. You've owned a production system end to end, including its roadmap, incidents and costs, and you've handed parts of it over to other engineers along the way.
You're comfortable with:

Using AI coding agents as a normal part of how you write code, with work you can show for it


Building AI applications that people can rely on: agents, retrieval (RAG), model APIs and gateways, along with the evaluations that show they behave as intended


Defining cloud infrastructure in code and shipping through CI/CD as part of how you build software, with the observability to see how it behaves once it's running


Practical security, from least privilege and secrets management to prompt injection defences


Writing well-tested, maintainable code in whatever language the problem calls for, and picking up a new one when you need to


You look for more efficient ways to build and run things, bring structure to an unclear situation without locking it down too early, and can explain a trade-off so that engineers, security and leadership all understand it. Fluent English is a must.
Why Coretura?
We're a joint venture between Volvo Group and Daimler Truck, building a shared software platform for the next generation of commercial vehicles. We're a young company with very little legacy to work around, backed by two of the world's largest commercial vehicle manufacturers.
The AI platform serves teams across the company, so your work will directly affect how they build and ship software.
If this sounds like the work you want to do, we look forward to your application.
Next steps Ready to build the future of commercial vehicles?
We review applications on a continuous basis, so don’t wait to submit yours!
Last application date: 4th of December 2026.
Questions? Don’t hesitate to reach out to Frida Greve, frida.greve@coretura.com if you have any questions regarding the position.
Please note we do not accept any applications via email.
About our recruitment process  We are committed to a safe and secure working environment. As a mandatory part of our recruitment process, we carry out drug and alcohol testing and background checks via 2Secure on the final candidate. The background check covers personal details, financial information, company engagements, legal matters, CV verification, media and internet presence, as well as a risk analysis and recommendation.

jobs.description:
Job Description

**Your role**
-------------

Atlas Copco Group operates in a rapidly changing environment shaped by technological disruption, geopolitical uncertainty, shifting competitive dynamics and increasingly interconnected markets. Management needs more than summaries of external events. It needs a clear understanding of what is changing, why it matters, which business assumptions may be challenged and what should be monitored or explored further.

As Strategic Risk Intelligence Specialist, you will strengthen the forward-looking capabilities of Group Risk Management. You will combine strategic intelligence, scenario planning, analytics and AI-enabled research to support discussions across Business Areas, Divisions and Group Functions. This is not a traditional compliance, insurance or risk-administration role. It is a business-oriented analytical position focused on uncertainty and decision support.

Your mission is to convert complex and sometimes conflicting information into clear, evidence-based insight. You will help identify emerging developments, develop plausible scenarios, monitor critical assumptions and create concise material for management discussions. You will own the intelligence process and analytical preparation, working closely with the Vice President Group Risk Management & Insurance and colleagues across the Group.

**Your day-to-day**
-------------------

**Strategic intelligence and horizon scanning**

* Monitor and analyze macro trends, external developments and emerging signals relevant to the Group’s businesses, markets and operating environment. This includes industrial technology, AI, competition, geopolitics, trade, macroeconomics, sustainability, supply chains, customers and business-model change.
* Produce concise intelligence reports, emerging-issue assessments and management briefings.
* Maintain a structured, traceable repository of trends, signals and supporting evidence.

**Scenario planning and strategic foresight**

* Develop plausible, differentiated and business-relevant scenarios.
* Develop and monitor signposts covering material uncertainties.
* Maintain a practical Group scenario library and support strategic stress testing and resilience assessments.
* Recommend topics requiring deeper analysis, escalation or management attention.

**Strategic risk analysis and decision support**

* Connect external intelligence with ERM, insurance and claims, loss prevention, supply-chain, resilience, financial and business information.
* Develop dashboards and visualizations that clarify implications and choices.

**AI-enabled risk intelligence**

* Use AI-enabled tools to improve horizon scanning, synthesis, scenario development and indicator monitoring.
* Define business problems, expected value, information requirements and success criteria for potential AI use cases.
* Work with the AI Expert, IT and data teams to develop appropriate solutions.

**ERM and management reporting support**

* Prepare analyses, scenarios and assumption maps for objective-centric ERM workshops.
* Add a forward-looking perspective to Group risk reporting and track management-attention topics over time.

**Collaboration and capability development**

* Collaborate with Business Areas, Divisions, Group Functions and internal subject-matter experts to understand context and validate conclusions.
* Work closely with colleagues in ERM, resilience, insurance, loss prevention, finance, strategy, IT, information security, legal and sustainability.
* Build an effective network of external intelligence sources and internal expertise.
* Share methods, tools and good practices for scenario analysis, assumption monitoring and AI-enabled

**Your skills and experience**
------------------------------

**What you bring**

* A master’s degree or equivalent qualification in engineering, economics, business administration, strategy, analytics, political science, international relations, technology or innovation management, or another relevant analytical field. Equivalent professional experience may also be considered
* Approximately five to eight years of relevant experience in corporate strategy, management consulting, strategic planning, business or market intelligence, strategic foresight, business development, risk analytics, enterprise risk management or data-driven business analysis.
* Strong ability to structure ambiguous questions, synthesize large amounts of information and translate analysis into business implications.
* Experience with scenario planning, strategic analysis, management reporting or comparable forward-looking analytical work.
* Hands-on experience using generative AI and analytical tools, combined with a critical approach to output quality and source validation. Programming or scripting experience (e.g. Python, SQL) and familiarity with APIs and integrations.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively across functions, cultures and organizational levels.
* Fluency in written and spoken English.

**It is an advantage if you have**

* Experience from a global industrial, engineering or technology-driven organization.
* Experience translating geopolitical, technological or competitive developments into business implications.
* Experience with Power BI or comparable visualization tools, advanced Excel and executive presentation development.
* Familiarity with ERM or GRC platforms and enterprise data environments.

**Who you are**  
You are intellectually curious and motivated by understanding how the operating environment is changing. You enjoy connecting developments across technology, markets, competition, geopolitics and business strategy. You are comfortable with ambiguity but disciplined about evidence. You can develop a hypothesis without becoming attached to it and revise your view when the evidence changes.
  
You combine strategic thinking with practical execution. You do not stop at describing a trend. You ask why it matters, which assumptions may be affected, what evidence supports the conclusion, what would indicate that conditions are changing and how the insight could influence a management decision.

We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every single requirement. We value diverse experiences and perspectives and are excited to see what you bring to the role.

----------------------------------

At Atlas Copco Group, we are committed to fair and equitable compensation. Compensation is determined based on the position and its responsibilities, without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, religion, physical ability, sexual orientation, marital status, or any other protected characteristic. Our compensation offering is designed to be locally relevant, competitive, and aligned with the expectations of current and future talent.

Beyond compensation, we believe that a rewarding career is about having opportunities to learn, grow, contribute, and develop in an environment built on trust, collaboration, and continuous improvement. At Atlas Copco Group, we support our people in building long-term careers while making a meaningful impact through their work.

**Your job location**
---------------------

This role offers a hybrid working arrangement, allowing you to split your time between working remotely and being on-site at our head office in Stockholm, Sweden (SE).

**Why it is great to work with us**
-----------------------------------

Your career grows through your skills, your curiosity, and the people you work with. You join a global network where we learn from each other and share knowledge openly. We focus on long‑term development and encourage you to explore new ideas that help us move forward. Innovation is part of how we think and act – we test, improve, and use what we learn to create solutions that matter. You can make a meaningful impact by contributing with your insights and taking ownership of your work, supported by flexible ways of working and leaders who empower you.

-----------------------

Our selection process includes interviews and, for some roles, skills assessments that help us gain a deeper understanding of your profile. About Epiminds
We’re building Lucy, an AI system that investigates marketing performance and carries approved changes through to execution.
Behind that work is a backend coordinating model calls, external APIs, persistent state, and code running in sandboxes. We’re a small team in Stockholm building the infrastructure this product needs.


The Problem
Agent workloads are difficult to predict. One request can become several parallel investigations. A task can pause for approval and continue later. A worker can disappear after an external API accepts a change but before the result is saved.
Retrying may duplicate the action. Giving up may leave the work unfinished. Keeping everything ready reduces latency but consumes idle compute.
The system has to know what happened, who owns the next step, and what is safe to repeat—while keeping data isolated and costs under control.


The Role
You’ll own the execution infrastructure, data systems, and reliability behind Lucy.
You’ll work across application code, databases, and cloud infrastructure, taking changes from design through deployment and operation. Your decisions will shape how the product handles more work and recovers when things fail.


What You’ll Do
Make execution durable. Build scheduling, queues, leases, cancellation, and recovery for work that outlives an individual request.
Make retries safe. Preserve execution state and prevent duplicate events from repeating external actions.
Run agent compute efficiently. Improve sandbox startup, worker scaling, resource limits, and cleanup.
Build dependable data flows. Handle pagination, partial failures, changing provider contracts, and datasets that should be streamed rather than held in memory.
Make failures explainable. Connect traces, logs, and cost data so the team can find bottlenecks and resolve incidents.

What We’re Looking For
You’ve operated backend systems in production and owned their reliability. You understand database design, distributed state, queues, and the difference between a failed request and a failed operation.
You’re comfortable with containers and cloud infrastructure. You can explain what breaks under load, how recovery works, and when a simpler design is enough.
Our stack includes TypeScript, Node.js, Supabase/PostgreSQL, Redis, Temporal, Cloud Run, GKE, Modal, Docker, and Pulumi.

Execution is central to the product. You’ll shape how agents run, how their work survives failures, and how infrastructure cost changes as usage grows.

jobs.title: Growth Marketer
jobs.description:
**BookBeat has grown to become one of the leading audiobook services in Europe, and our aim is to be a part of our users’ everyday lives. Our growth journey continues, and we are constantly working to attract, convert, and retain more people to our service. Our owned channels (email, push notifications, in-app and web messages, and SMS) play a big part in that. To scale our growth initiatives across the customer lifecycle in all our markets, we are now strengthening the team with a creative and energetic Growth Marketer who wants to learn the craft from the inside!**

In this role, you will play a key part in growing and engaging our user base through creative, data-driven campaigns and initiatives across the entire customer lifecycle. You will work at the intersection of creativity, sales, and analytics - using insights to inform our commercial strategy and drive results along the lifecycle: from acquisition, to loyalty & engagement, to churn prevention & retention. You will be part of Team Growth Marketing, but also collaborate closely with the broader international Marketing & Sales team - filled with sharp marketers, brand designers, and analysts. We believe you are eager to learn and grow, and are at the beginning of your career with a year or two of hands-on experience. But what matters most to us is finding someone with the right energy, curiosity, commercial mindset, and a “get-things-done” attitude. The role is based at BookBeat’s headquarters in Stockholm and you will report to our Growth Marketing Director.

**Some things you will do:**

* Drive user growth using owned channels (email, web, app, push, etc.) via Braze
* Plan, create, and optimize campaigns aligned with key performance indicators (KPIs)
* Develop creative marketing concepts and write compelling copy
* Analyze and report campaign performance
* Conduct A/B tests and experimentation to improve outcomes
* Use audience segmentation and data analysis to personalize communication
* Use AI tools and workflows to work smarter, and share what you learn with your colleagues
* Collaborate with local marketers, brand designers, analysts, developers, and content specialists

**As a person, you:**

* Are ambitious, energetic, positive, and proactive
* Are self-motivated and eager to learn
* Enjoy brainstorming creative ideas and thinking outside the box
* Strive to make data-informed decisions in everything you do
* Have a commercial mindset and are excited by opportunities to drive sales
* Are excited about the future of AI and want to learn more
* Thrive in a collaborative team environment and enjoy working from the office, where we spend four days a week

**We also want you to:**

* Have 1-3 years of experience from CRM, lifecycle- or B2C marketing, or from working with a consumer product in another role
* Have knowledge about customer engagement platforms like Braze (you can learn, but it is a significant advantage)
* Be fluent in English and preferably Swedish. Another language from one of our markets is a big plus (Swedish, Finnish, German, Polish, Dutch, Norwegian or Danish)
* Have a university degree in business, marketing, communications, or similar

Do you think you’re the right match? Then we can’t wait to see your application! If you have any questions, contact our Growth Marketing Director Philip Svenningsson at philip.svenningsson@bookbeat.com. We are actively reviewing applications.

**What comes with joining BookBeat AB:**  
30 days of paid vacation  
️ One extra day off per year through reduced working hours  
ITP1 occupational pension and flex pension option  
Insurance, including occupational group life, work injury and business travel insurance  
Annual wellness allowance, weekly wellness hour and monthly activity clubs  
BookBeat subscription for you and your loved ones  
Working equipment, including a computer, phone and phone subscription  
Subsidised occupational health care option  
Collective agreement  
Parental leave benefits  
A sustainable work-life balance with a 37.9-hour work week  
Flexibility in your everyday work, including flexible working hours  
Opportunities to keep growing through challenging tasks, learning opportunities and educational resources  
Knowledge sharing sessions within and across teams  
Regular breakfasts, team activities, holiday parties, roadmap days and other moments that bring us together  
A centrally located HQ in the heart of Stockholm, with access to our office gym, sauna and dog room  
Discounts and benefits through Bonnier, e.g. yearly bike service

**A bit about BookBeat**  
BookBeat’s journey began in 2015, with the ambition to create a market-leading service for digital books. In 2016, the BookBeat app was launched.

Today, around 10 years since our launch, more than one million people use BookBeat every month. We’re part of Bonnier Books and continue to grow across Europe with plenty of pages still left to write.

Team BookBeat now consists of around 170 curious and committed doers, working across areas such as tech, product development, books, marketing & sales, finance, business development and people operations.

What brings us together is not just what we do, but how we do it. Our four core values guide the way we work, collaborate and grow:

*Be great at what you do*  
*Share what you know*  
*Curiosity for our users and us*  
*Build Team BookBeat*

In practice, this means we want people to keep developing within their area of expertise, while also sharing knowledge generously with others. We work closely across teams, learn from each other and stay curious about our users, our product and the journey we’re on. We also believe that everyone contributes to the culture we build together. Whether it’s through collaboration, feedback, new ideas or simply helping a colleague out, we all play a part in making BookBeat a place where people can do great work and enjoy the journey along the way.

jobs.title: Hydraulics Engineer
jobs.description:
Stockholm – Full-time
Wind helped us discover our planet — now it can help us preserve it.
On behalf of AlfaWall Oceanbird, we are now looking for a Hydraulics Engineer to join their fast-growing and highly innovative team in Stockholm.
Oceanbird is driving a revolution within sustainable shipping by developing wing sail technology for the global maritime market. The company is a 50/50 joint venture between Alfa Laval and Wallenius, backed by strong industrial expertise but operating as an independent, forward-leaning organization.
This is a unique opportunity to be part of a company at the forefront of transforming global shipping.

About the role
The hydraulic system is at the very core of Oceanbird’s wing sail technology — essentially acting as its heart and muscles. It consists of a large main hydraulic power unit, a backup system, cylinders and motors enabling the wing’s main actuation functions.
The project is currently in an exciting phase, with the first full-scale system being tested at their test site in Landskrona.

Your responsibilities
In this role, you will:

Design hydraulic systems and create hydraulic schematic diagrams


Select key components such as valves, pumps, filters and piping


Perform hands-on testing, including measurements and analysis of results


Ensure system safety and conduct risk assessments


Participate in testing and commissioning onboard vessels


Define requirements, concepts and solutions for future generations of the system


Act as the technical interface towards suppliers


Support regulatory processes and documentation



Who we are looking for
To succeed in this role, you likely have:

A Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in hydraulics, mechanical or mechatronics engineering


Experience or education within hydraulic system design


A self-driven and proactive mindset


Strong collaboration skills and a team-oriented approach



Meriting experience
It is considered a strong advantage if you have experience in one or more of the following:

Practical hydraulic installation work


Hydraulic testing, measurement tools and data analysis


Hydraulic design tools (preferably HyDraw)


Control systems, sensors and electrical installations


Modeling and simulation (Matlab/Simulink)


Mechanical CAD (preferably CREO)


Cross-functional engineering collaboration


Marine industry experience and knowledge of DNV regulations



Additional information
The role involves regular travel to the test site in Landskrona, as well as participation in commissioning onboard oceangoing vessels.
Relocation support is available for the right candidate.

jobs.title: Junior Simuleringsingenjör inom Termodynamik
jobs.description:
Hur kan simuleringar bidra till att utveckla effektivare motorer, optimera kylsystem och förbättra hur olika tekniska system samverkar i ett fordon? Här får du arbeta med avancerade simuleringsmetoder hos en global aktör inom fordonsindustrin, där dina analyser blir en viktig del av utvecklingen av framtidens fordon. En möjlighet för dig som vill fördjupa dina tekniska kunskaper, arbeta nära erfarna ingenjörer och få en bred förståelse för fordonsutveckling. Om tjänsten: Som junior simuleringsingenjör blir du en del av ett erfaret team på cirka tio ingenjörer som arbetar med simulering och analys av olika system inom fordonsutveckling.
  
  
Teamet är uppdelat i tre teknikområden med fokus på motor- och kylsystem, smörjning och elektriska maskiner samt termodynamik ur ett helfordonsperspektiv. Beroende på din bakgrund och ditt tekniska intresse får du möjlighet att fördjupa dig inom det område där din kompetens passar bäst. I rollen arbetar du med att undersöka hur olika tekniska system fungerar och påverkas under varierande förhållanden. Du tar dig an frågeställningar från utvecklingsorganisationen, samlar in tekniska underlag och bygger upp simuleringar för att analysera exempelvis temperaturer, flöden och systemens beteende.
  
  
Arbetet sker i nära samarbete med andra ingenjörer och tekniska specialister, där resultaten används som underlag för vidare utveckling och tekniska beslut. Du får arbeta med avancerade verktyg som STAR-CCM+ och GT-Power och blir en del av en internationell utvecklingsmiljö med många tekniska kontaktytor. Som junior får du stöd av seniora kollegor och möjlighet att successivt utveckla både din simuleringskompetens och din förståelse för hela produktutvecklingsprocessen. Exempel på arbetsuppgifter: Genomföra simuleringar och analyser av termiska system, flöden och fordonskomponenter.
  
  
Bygga upp och vidareutveckla simuleringsmodeller utifrån tekniska frågeställningar och konstruktionsunderlag. Analysera simuleringsresultat och utvärdera olika tekniska lösningar. Arbeta med simuleringsverktyg som STAR-CCM+ och GT-Power. Sammanställa tekniska rapporter och presentera resultat för berörda utvecklingsteam.
  
  
Samarbeta med utvecklingsingenjörer och andra specialister för att bidra till produktutvecklingen. Vi söker dig som: Har en civilingenjörsexamen eller motsvarande masterutbildning inom exempelvis maskinteknik, farkostteknik, teknisk fysik, aerodynamik eller närliggande område. Har grundläggande kunskaper inom termodynamik, strömningslära eller närliggande tekniska områden. Har ett intresse för simulering, teknisk analys och fordonsutveckling.
  
  
Har goda kunskaper i engelska, i både tal och skrift. Det är meriterande om du har: Erfarenhet av simulering genom examensarbete, universitetsprojekt eller tidigare arbetslivserfarenhet. Kunskaper inom CFD, 1D- eller 3D-simulering. Erfarenhet av verktyg som STAR-CCM+, GT-Power eller CATIA.
  
  
Kunskaper inom programmering eller ett intresse för AI och automatisering. För att trivas i rollen tror vi att du är analytisk, nyfiken och har ett genuint intresse för att förstå hur tekniska system fungerar. Du tycker om att samarbeta med andra, är kommunikativ och vågar ställa frågor för att komma vidare i ditt arbete. Vi tror också att du har ett eget driv och motiveras av att utveckla din tekniska kompetens tillsammans med mer erfarna kollegor.

Om Friday På Friday brinner vi för att ge dig som Tech-talang en riktigt bra start på karriären. Vi värderar ambition och potential högt och arbetar aktivt för en fördomsfri rekrytering där alla ges samma möjlighet att lyckas. Vi finns i Stockholm, Göteborg, Malmö, Linköping och Örebro. jobs.title: AI Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Vill du arbeta nära AI och digitalisering och samtidigt vara den som får människor, teknik och verksamhet att mötas? Här väntar en möjlighet att komma nära en växande AI-satsning och vara med när nya idéer tar form.
Om kunden
Vår kund är en global industrikoncern med verksamhet inom marin teknik. Inom teamet arbetar man med uppkopplad marin utrustning, digitala tjänster, data och AI. Nu växlar organisationen upp sitt AI-arbete med flera nya initiativ och applikationer, där fokus ligger på att omsätta ny teknik till lösningar som effektiviserar arbetssätt och skapar konkret verksamhetsnytta.

Din styrka ligger i att förstå behov, se möjligheter, samla rätt personer och skapa den struktur och framdrift som krävs för att få idéer att bli verklighet.

Du följer arbetet tillsammans med utvecklingspartnern, deltar i avstämningar och demonstrationer och säkerställer att verksamhetens perspektiv finns med genom hela processen. Parallellt träffar du användare och olika delar av organisationen för att förstå deras utmaningar, samla in behov och identifiera nya områden där AI kan göra verklig skillnad.
Du kommer bland annat att:

Fånga upp verksamhetens behov och omsätta dem till tydliga krav

Identifiera processer och arbetssätt där AI kan skapa verksamhetsnytta


Bidra i workshops, presentationer och interna dialoger kring AI och digitalisering

För den här rollen söker vi dig som har en god förståelse för AI och framför allt ett intresse för hur tekniken kan användas för att utveckla verksamheter och arbetssätt. Förmåga att förstå verksamhetsbehov och kommunicera dem vidare till tekniska kompetenser

Ett strukturerat arbetssätt och förmåga att hålla ihop flera aktiviteter parallellt


Flytande engelska i tal och skrift

Som person är du nyfiken och initiativtagande med ett naturligt intresse för ny teknik. Du har lätt för att skapa relationer och trivs med många kontaktytor. Samtidigt är du prestigelös och lösningsorienterad och känner dig bekväm i en miljö där allt inte är färdigdefinierat från början.

Goda kunskaper i SQL och förståelse för datamodellering.

Vi söker en erfaren HR-specialist som ska ge kvalificerat och operativt HR-stöd till chefer i personalrelaterade frågor.

Du ska ha relevant HR-utbildning eller motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Meta Bytes söker en erfaren systemutvecklare med känsla för arkitektur till vårt kontor i Laholm. Du älskar att skriva bra kod, har ett öga för genomtänkt systemarkitektur och trivs med att ta ett stort tekniskt ansvar. Hos oss blir du en viktig teknisk drivkraft i våra projekt, med fokus på lösningar i Microsoft Azure.
Rollen innebär ansvar, frihet och ett nära samarbete med både kunder och flera av våra utvecklingsteam. Hos oss är människor, öppenhet, samarbete, lekfullhet och förtroende värden som vi prioriterar högt. Det är viktigt att må bra och ha roligt på jobbet!
Är detta en roll som passar in på dig? Trivs du i ett bolag och i ett team som genomsyras av ett agilt tankesätt? Då uppmanar vi dig att söka tjänsten omgående då vi intervjuar för rollen löpande.
Vad kommer du pyssla med om dagarna?
Ta fram skalbara och säkra lösningar utifrån kundkrav tillsammans med andra duktiga utvecklare


Skriva närproducerad, ekologisk, GMO-fri och välstrukturerad kod


Utveckla komplexa system baserat på microservices-arkitektur, med Microsoft Azure som huvudsaklig molnplattform


Driva tekniska beslut och säkerställa en genomtänkt arkitektur med fokus på kvalitet, prestanda och långsiktig förvaltning


Guida våra kunder i val av lösningar och tekniker och skapa värde för dem med en iterativ approach


Vara med i hela utvecklingsprocessen från planering och implementation till driftsättning och löpande underhåll

Vad erbjuder vi?
En flexibel, öppen och nördig miljö med möjligheter att administrera över sin egen tid och jobba hemifrån


Trevliga kollegor och ett hundvänligt kontor


Möjlighet till mycket ansvar och att kunna påverka arbetet och den utveckling och tjänster som levereras


Brett arbetsområde med stora möjligheter till personlig utveckling


Expanderande företag med öppet sinne för idéer


Högt i tak med transparent ledning


Bekväm soffa för välplanerade tupplurar


Friskvårdsbidrag, frukt, nötter och kaffe/te (och glass ibland)

Om dig
Du har minst två till tre års erfarenhet inom mjukvaruutveckling men dina grannar tror att du jobbar med att fixa skrivare och hårddiskar


Du har hunnit samla på dig både teknisk spetskompetens och en förståelse för hur man bygger hållbara system.


Du har erfarenhet av att designa systemarkitektur och omsätta tekniska vägval till fungerande lösningar. Du kan se helheten, identifiera risker och göra kloka avvägningar mellan teknik, affärsnytta och långsiktig hållbarhet.


Du har god erfarenhet av molnbaserad utveckling, främst inom Microsoft Azure, och förstår hur man bygger, driftsätter och förvaltar moderna molnlösningar.


Pluspoäng om du har erfarenhet av Platform Engineering och inte räds att kavla upp ärmarna som DevOpsare när det behövs.


Du är trygg i att ta tekniskt ansvar, driva utvecklingen framåt och vägleda andra utvecklare. Du delar gärna med dig av din kunskap och kan skapa samsyn kring arkitektur, kodkvalitet och tekniska vägval.


Du trivs lika bra med att fördjupa dig i kod som att diskutera arkitektur och tekniska vägval. Du vill inte bara rita lösningar – du vill vara med och bygga dem också.


Du har erfarenhet av AI verktyg för utveckling (och har koll på både fördelarna och begränsningarna)


Du har riktigt bra kunskaper inom .NET eller Golang, och har inget emot att lära dig nya språk (erfarenhet av andra högnivå-språk ser vi som grädde på moset)


Du har ett brinnande intresse för teknik och systemutveckling och berättar gärna om dina hobbyprojekt, såsom hemautomation av våffeljärnet


Du ser lärande och egen utveckling som en väsentlig del av ditt arbete


Du har mycket bra svenskt och engelskt tal och skrift (extra intressant med kunskaper i esperanto, knoparmoj eller rövarspråk)


Du är en hejare på problemlösning, hjälper mer än gärna dina kollegor och bidrar till god stämning i ditt team

Pluspoäng för kunskaper inom
Platform engineering


Kubernetes


Analog-tv eller frimärken


Maskininlärning


Dåliga skämt och ordvitsar


Har du frågor om tjänsten? Skriv till jobs@metabytes.se.
